title: Bravo, questa è costanza
subtitle: Don Alfonso, Ferrando and Guglielmo: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 9, recitative after No. 27
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (fù; Guglielmo, where the libretto has Guilelmo; vo without its apostrophe; Don Alfonso's Venite; o spero, where the libretto has io spero; the dots printed after calcolo left out, as the libretto has none there, and those after noi and merto given as one ellipsis each).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 280–282, the recitative after No. 27 (35 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 5, 6, 9, 10, 15, 17, 19, 29 and 33), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. From bar 30 Don Alfonso's last lines (“che folle è quel cervello…”) are a short arioso in 6/8 with the orchestra; the trill in bar 34 ends with two small notes, written as grace notes. It ends with the curtain (“Vorhang zu”). Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100, estimated (no separate timing of this recitative was found; about 1¼ minutes).
